Ticket T-8015, URGENT owner rule: 'if a number can't be shown accurately, remove it from the view; no estimates shown as facts.' The board shows Billed today $0.00 while real API money was spent, and List value $0.00 after a day of runs. Remove EVERY money figure from Swarm Watch views until a real billing source exists. Keep the spend files, tools/spend.mjs, project-spend.mjs and every server-side cap/budget enforcement exactly as they are (caps must still stop runs).
(1) API layer, tools/watch-cli.mjs (createBoardApi: snapshot for /api/board ~370-439, project ~443, live ~452): add and export stripMoney(value) that deep-copies a response and removes every key whose name matches /usd|Usd|USD|cost|Cost|billed|Billed|listValue|flatRate|price|Price|spend|Spend|budget|Budget/ (document the list; keep non-money keys such as capBasis only if they carry no number; drop whole spend/cost/cap objects), and apply it to every /api/board, /api/project and /api/live response before it is sent. Do not change board-data.mjs or build-progress.mjs (another branch is editing them).
(2) UI: tools/watch-assets/board.js: remove the overview tiles Billed today, List value today, Billed all time, List value all time (~158-161); make capCell (~208-228) and its callers (~352, ~364, ~514) show no money (remove the cap column/cell entirely from the projects table and cards); on the Cost tab (~455-520) remove every money tile (Billed today/7 days/all time, Flat-rate list value, Orchestrator list value, Estimated full cost), the per-project money table, and the money and dollar-cap columns of the lanes table (keep lane name, kind and status/jobs text only; if the tab is then empty of useful content, rename it 'Lanes'), and any '$' shown elsewhere (~596 e.usd). Remove the usd() helper if unused. tools/watch-assets/project.js: remove the spend/cost tiles (~210-217) and any other money figure. tools/watch-assets/project-live.js: remove 'Spend today' (~78) and any money figure. Hide, never show zero.
(3) tests/board-no-money.test.mjs: build a board with real-shaped data that HAS spend (runs with costUsd, spend files) the way tests/board-page.test.mjs does, call the /api/board, /api/project and /api/live handlers (or createBoardApi) and assert no key matching the money pattern exists anywhere in the JSON and no string contains a '$' followed by a digit; a static scan of tools/watch-assets/board.js, project.js, project-live.js finds no 'Billed', 'List value', 'list value', 'usd(' or '\$' + digit output; and a cap still stops a run (call the existing cap check with spend over the cap and assert it refuses: find it in tools/spend.mjs or project-spend.mjs). Update existing tests that asserted money fields in these responses or pages (tests/board-page.test.mjs, tests/watch-ui.test.mjs, tests/board-live.test.mjs and any other): remove only the money assertions and list each in your notes. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-no-money.test.mjs tests/board-*.test.mjs tests/watch-ui.test.mjs tests/watch-assets.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
